reference: Before this market, he used to believe every seller's story.
sk: Pred týmto trhom veril každému predavačovi jeho príbeh.
cz: Před tímhle trhem věřil každému prodavači jeho příběh.
acceptable: Before this market he used to believe {every|each} {seller's|vendor's|trader's|stallholder's} story.
He used to believe {every|each} {seller's|vendor's|trader's|stallholder's} story before this market.

mistakes.text: Before this market he believed every {seller's|vendor's} story.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of used to
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pre minulý stav, ktorý už neplatí, sa tu hodí „used to believe“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pro minulý stav, který už neplatí, se tu hodí „used to believe“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a past state that is no longer true, “used to believe” fits best here.

mistakes.text: Before this market he use to believe every {seller's|vendor's} story.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V kladnej vete o minulosti sa píše „used to“ s „-d“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V kladné větě o minulosti se píše „used to“ s „-d“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In a positive sentence about the past, write “used to” with “-d”.

mistakes.text: Before this market he used to believed every {seller's|vendor's} story.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „used to“ patrí base form bez koncovky: „used to believe“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „used to“ následuje base form bez koncovky: „used to believe“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “used to” use the bare verb: “used to believe”.

mistakes.text: Before this market he was used to {believe|believing} every {seller's|vendor's} story.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Be used to“ znamená byť zvyknutý; minulý stav vyjadruje „used to believe“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Be used to“ znamená být zvyklý; minulý stav vyjadřuje „used to believe“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Be used to” means “be accustomed to”; for a past state use “used to believe”.

mistakes.text: Before this market he would believe every {seller's|vendor's} story.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Would“ sa nepoužíva so state verbs ako „believe“; tu patrí „used to“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Would“ se nepoužívá se state verbs jako „believe“; sem patří „used to“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Would” isn't used with state verbs like “believe”; use “used to” here.

mistakes.text: Before this market he used to believe to every {seller's|vendor's} story.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „believe“ nepatrí „to“, predmet ide hneď za sloveso.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „believe“ nepatří „to“, předmět jde hned za sloveso.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't put “to” after “believe”; the object follows the verb directly.
